Como será o seu dia a dia?

Nessa jornada conosco, você vai:

  • Liderar operacionalmente o Discovery de iniciativas pré-definidas, em alinhamento com a liderança e autoridade de design dos Especialistas do time e com os stakeholders das áreas envolvidas.
  • Estruturar problemas, perguntas-chave, hipóteses, planos de pesquisa e critérios de decisão; organizar entrevistas, workshops, benchmarks e análises de mercado.
  • Sintetizar necessidades de clientes e usuários, dimensionar oportunidades e traduzir aprendizados em proposta de valor, conceitos de solução e alternativas de modelo de negócio.
  • Suportar na construção de análises econômicas e business cases preliminares, incluindo premissas, cenários, sensibilidades, riscos e indicadores de sucesso.
  • Planejar e acompanhar experimentos, PoCs e MVPs em parceria com especialistas e Product Owner, assegurando rastreabilidade entre hipótese, evidência e recomendação.
  • Produzir narrativas e recomendações executivas; apresentar conclusões, explicitar trade-offs e propor próximos passos nos gates do portfólio.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Curiosidade intelectual, julgamento, autonomia e conforto com ambiguidade.
  • Problem solving estruturado, com rigor analítico e capacidade de síntese executiva.
  • Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, discovery e experimentação.
  • Modelagem financeira e leitura e compreensão de alavancas de negócio.
  • Comunicação clara, facilitação e influência transversal.
  • Gostar de ambientes dinâmicos e ambíguos, de exercitar a flexibilidade, pragmatismo, resiliência.
  • Capacidade comprovada de conduzir entregas multidisciplinares com supervisão por checkpoints, e não por microgestão, com organização para lidar com conteúdos, prazos, metas.
  • Experiência profissional em estratégia, consultoria, inovação, novos negócios, produto ou inteligência de mercado.
  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio de Excel e PowerPoint.

EML Payments is a global leader in the fintech space. Our mission is to create awesome, instant, and secure payment solutions that connect our customers to their customers, anytime, anywhere, wherever money is in motion. Our Purpose is to inspire transformative digital change for our customers and communities.

As an issuer and processor, we provide our clients and partners with innovative alternatives to traditional banking solutions for reloadable and non-reloadable programs. We are agile, we are innovative. We take a partnership approach; we tailor solutions and place a strong focus on operational excellence.

The team you'll be joining

Our Payment Operations & Change team plays a key role in EML's transformation journey, modernising processes, driving automation, and creating a best-in-class operation. The team manages projects and operational initiatives while overseeing critical relationships with payment networks, card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), acquirers, processors, card bureaus, and associated service providers across Australia and globally.

We work closely with teams across the business, including our Scheme Management function, to deliver operational excellence and drive cost efficiency. Our collaborative approach ensures we are ready to meet evolving customer and regulatory needs in Australia and globally.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Project Manager who thrives on delivery and takes pride in seeing initiatives through to completion. This role is critical to EML's global Operations team, delivering card scheme and tokenisation projects, payment operations transformation and cross-functional initiatives.

You will have subject matter knowledge of the Payments industry, be detail-oriented and have a track record of delivery. Success in this role means combining structured project management, including clear planning, risk management, governance, and clear accountability, with the agility to roll up your sleeves and drive actions forward.

You will be a safe pair of hands in the Payment Operations team, supporting both large and small initiatives. From individual client delivery projects, and associated reporting, to improving our card scheme project delivery for efficiency and scale.

This role demands exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. You will provide clarity and confidence through concise, accurate reporting and updates.

What you'll do

  • Manage a portfolio of complex initiatives that span one or multiple lines of business, with a focus on payments and card projects.
  • Own full project lifecycle delivery, from initiation through to deployment and BAU handover, for one or more initiatives simultaneously.
  • Lead delivery of card scheme mandate changes (Visa and Mastercard) and BIN/program implementations, partnering with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive delivery of compliance-related initiatives (e.g., data integrity program, regulatory requirements) to ensure obligations are met on time.
  • Report on project success criteria results, metrics, testing, and deployment management activities.
  • Provide a delivery focus within the Payment Operations team, coordinating and driving completion of process improvements and transformation initiatives.
  • Work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment demonstrating teamwork, innovation, and excellence.
  • Prepare appropriate trackers or detailed project plans covering all phases of your projects.
  • Procure and manage adequate resources to achieve project objectives in planned timeframes.
  • Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources, and provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and issues.
  • Understand interdependencies between technology, operations, compliance, and business needs.
  • Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.
  • Delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate personnel, and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders, team members, clients, and other stakeholders.
  • Continue professional development to keep abreast of emerging technologies, methods, and best practices in payments and project delivery.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in appropriate field of study or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of project management experience within the Payments industry, including tracking and planning projects.
  • Experience delivering projects in payments, card issuing or financial services (e.g. scheme mandate rollouts, BIN/Program implementations, compliance remediation) is highly regarded.
  • Familiarity with the Australian payments landscape (AP+, AusPaynet, AUSTRAC, ePayment Code, RBA frameworks) is advantageous.
  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, with experience presenting to stakeholders and/or Senior Leadership.
  • Interpersonal skills to influence and spur change, facilitate, and enhance performance within a cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrate decisiveness in resolving business problems, making decisions, and identifying priorities.
  • Experience negotiating vendor contracts.
  • Experience drafting and submitting budget proposals and recommending subsequent budget changes where necessary.
  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs on time and on schedule and within budget parameters.
  • Experience leading, motivating, and managing various project and program team sizes, including internal and external resources, while holding team accountable for performance.
  • Experience influencing and gaining buy-in from executives, sponsors, team members, stakeholders, and peers.

Behavioural & Communication

  • Bias for Action: You unblock, decide, and deliver.
  • Governance Balance: Apply minimum effective process for speed and control.
  • Excellent Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage at all levels, summarise complex information clearly, and influence decisions effectively.
  • Decisiveness: Demonstrate sound judgement in resolving business problems, making decisions, and identifying priorities.

Who we are

Bayzat is at the forefront of transforming workplaces through innovative solutions in HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance. Renowned as a leading SaaS platform for employee benefits and a key player in the Insurance sector, we are committed to our mission: empower every company to create a remarkable workplace by supercharging people processes and payments.

As one of the MENA region's fastest-growing Scale-Ups, Bayzat is celebrated for its innovative product offerings, backed by over 300 team members from 35+ nationalities. Recognized by Forbes as a promising UAE-based startup and supported by leading VCs like Mubadala and Point72 Ventures, we are among the best-funded HRTech scale-ups in the region.

At Bayzat, culture is paramount. We are a principle-driven, merit-based organization where authenticity, collaboration, and unpretentiousness thrive. Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimize efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.

About the Role

We’re hiring across multiple levels in our Insurance Sales team—whether you're a high-potential junior or a seasoned sales professional, this role offers the chance to drive impact in the Group Health Insurance space. Strong communication, presentation skills, and a sales-first mindset are key, regardless of prior insurance experience.

Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:

  • Effectively manage and drive the sales cycle from prospecting to successful closure
  • Approach potential customers with the aim of winning new business, relationship building, researching the market and related products, presenting our product in a structured and professional way
  • Help potential clients understand our value proposition and providing them a general understanding of the insurance industry landscape
  • Win 25%+ of deals sourced by inbound & outbound sales development, as well as deals sourced independently
  • Provide excellent customer service and look for ways to enhance the client experience
  • Achieve and aim to exceed assigned targets within agreed timelines
  • Build a sustainable and robust pipeline quarter by quarter, ensuring accurate and rigorous forecasting and account planning
  • Cultivate a supportive and high-performing culture within the Sales Team and wider business
  • Adapt to a fast-paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Develop a core understanding of insurance concepts

What you will need to have

  • A strong sales and business background centered on the Insurance side is highly desirable
  • Ideally 3 to 7 years of sales experience; with at least 1 year of local market experience
  • Deep understanding of key industry solutions and competitive technologies
  • Propensity to dissect client challenges and provide creative solutions
  • Self-starter that comes into every day with a plan to execute their goals
  • A skillful presenter with excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Building strong relationships with colleagues, effectively collaborating across departments, and inspiring everyone around to do great work
  • Ambitious, energetic, tenacious, full of positivity, and, hungry to be the best
  • Ability to stay focused on key tasks in a fast-paced environment

What’s in it for You

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture — we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

  • Meritocracy at its core: Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
  • Freedom to shape your path: We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
  • Real feedback culture: Feedback is coaching - empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
  • Barrier-free collaboration: Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table — even with the CEO.
  • Accelerated growth: Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
  • Flexible work setup: Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
  • Inclusive culture: Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone — but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, welcome to Bayzat.

팀 소개

리워드로 사람의 참여를 만들고, 그 참여에서 새로운 사업의 가능성을 찾습니다. 리워드는 유저에게 새로운 서비스를 경험할 이유를 주고, 광고주에게는 고객을 만날 기회를, 매체에게는 수익과 재방문의 기회를 만듭니다. 버즈빌 Frontier의 Global Market파트는 이 세 가지 가치를 하나의 사업으로 연결합니다. 국내 리워드 광고에서 쌓은 경험을 바탕으로 새로운 광고 상품과 제휴 모델을 만들고, 그 가능성을 해외 시장으로 확장하는 팀입니다.

우리의 미션은 국내에서 만든 리워드 성과를 해외에서도 재현할 수 있는 사업으로 키우고, 그 과정에서 리워드 산업의 새로운 성장 기회를 만드는 것입니다.

직무 소개

  • 리워드 ADN 광고 운영: 네이버 CPA 등 리워드 광고의 캠페인 세팅·QA·라이브를 관리하고, 공급사·상품·매체별 물량, 단가, 예산/캡과 할당 상태를 점검하며 파트너·내부 담당자와 조율합니다.
  • 성과·수익성 개선: 요청·노출·클릭·전환과 광고 수익·매체비·리워드 비용을 확인하고, 지표의 집계 기준과 비용 중복을 대사합니다. 비교 조건을 맞춰 지면 확대·프로모션·운영 변경의 효과를 검증합니다.
  • 파트너 대응·정산 검증: 공급사별 운영 조건과 변경 사항을 관리하고, 전환 인정 건수·단가·기간·통화·반올림 기준을 맞춰 내부/파트너 리포트를 대사합니다. 차액·인보이스·정산 증빙·미수금의 후속 처리를 정산·재무 담당자와 확인합니다.
  • 운영 이슈·제품 개선: 광고 미노출·미션 할당·적립·CS 이슈를 재현 조건과 데이터로 정리하고, PM·개발·CS와 수정·재검증까지 추적합니다. 반복되는 수동 설정과 검증을 체크리스트·운영 기능·AI 활용으로 개선합니다.
  • 국내 성과의 해외 적용: 국내 상품의 성과 조건과 한계를 정리해 해외에 적용할 대상을 찾고, 현지 광고 공급·리워드·지면·유저 행동·정산 조건을 확인하며 연동·QA·출시·프로모션·초기 성과 검증을 진행합니다. 해외 ADN 캠페인의 단가 연동·라이브·운영 이슈도 담당자와 조율합니다.

팀 소개

버즈빌의 다음 챕터를 이끌 마케팅 리더를 찾습니다.

버즈빌은 지난 10여 년간 독보적인 리워드 기술로 수많은 프리미엄 매체와 브랜드, 그리고 사용자를 연결하며 애드테크 시장의 혁신을 주도해왔습니다. 이제 우리는 축적된 데이터와 AI 기술을 바탕으로, 브랜드와 사용자가 만나는 방식을 새롭게 설계하는 인터랙션 AI 에이전트 기업으로의 위대한 도약을 앞두고 있습니다.

이 여정의 중심에서, 당신은 버즈빌의 마케팅 조직을 이끌며 비즈니스의 미래를 그리는 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 단순히 마케팅 팀을 관리하는 것을 넘어, 회사의 핵심 리더십 팀과 함께 버즈빌의 다음 성장 단계를 정의하고, AI를 무기로 마케팅이 일하는 방식을 새롭게 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

당신이 마주할 도전 (The Opportunity & Challenge)

  • 빠르게 변화하는 AI 시대의 광고 생태계 속에서 버즈빌이 어떤 회사인지 시장에 어떻게 새롭게 각인시킬 것인가?
  • AI를 통해 마케팅이 일하는 방식을 어떻게 더 빠르고 효과적으로 바꿔갈 것인가?
  • 버즈빌의 이야기를 고객과 업계, 언론이 신뢰하는 브랜드로 어떻게 만들어갈 것인가?

당신은 이 질문에 대한 답을 찾아가며, 버즈빌 마케팅과 커뮤니케이션의 모든 전략과 실행을 총괄하는 미션을 수행하게 됩니다.

직무 소개

1. Marketing Vision & Strategy Ownership

  • 회사의 비즈니스 목표와 연계된 중장기 마케팅 비전과 전략을 수립하고 실행을 총괄합니다.
  • 세일즈, 프로덕트 등 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 얼라인을 통해 전사적 성장 전략을 함께 만들어갑니다.
  • 데이터에 기반하여 마케팅 예산을 기획하고, 성과를 극대화하기 위한 리소스 분배를 책임집니다.

2. AI Native Marketing

  • AI를 기반으로 마케팅의 기획부터 실행, 분석까지 일하는 방식을 재설계하고, 팀이 더 빠르고 효과적으로 일할 수 있는 환경을 만듭니다.
  • 새로운 AI 도구와 방식을 먼저 시도하고, 검증된 방식을 팀의 일하는 방식으로 정착시킵니다.

3. Brand & Corporate Communication

  • 회사의 다음 성장 단계에 맞춰 기업 브랜드와 핵심 메시지를 재정립하고, 시장에 버즈빌의 가치를 명확하게 전달합니다.
  • 핵심 미디어와의 관계 구축 및 PR 활동을 통해 버즈빌과 경영진의 목소리를 확산시키고, 이슈 커뮤니케이션 체계를 마련합니다.
  • 고객, 파트너, 업계, 잠재 인재까지 아우르는 일관된 브랜드 경험을 만들어갑니다.

4. High-Performing Team Leadership

  • 빠른 실행 위주의 의사결정 문화를 팀에 내재화하고, 팀원 개개인이 최고의 퍼포먼스를 낼 수 있도록 동기를 부여하고 성장시킵니다.
  • 목표 달성을 위해 팀의 구조와 R&R을 지속적으로 최적화하며 업계 최고의 마케팅 조직을 구축합니다.

자격요건

  • 8년 이상의 B2B 마케팅 또는 그에 준하는 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 애드테크/마테크, AI 또는 B2B SaaS 산업에서 마케팅 전략을 수립하고 팀을 성공적으로 이끌어 본 경험이 있는 분
  • AI를 실무에 직접 활용해 마케팅의 기획, 실행, 분석 방식을 개선하고 이를 구체적인 성과로 만들어 본 분
  • 기업 PR 전략을 수립하고 실행하며, 핵심 미디어와의 관계를 바탕으로 브랜드 인지도와 신뢰도를 높여 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 비즈니스 목표와 연계된 마케팅 전략을 수립하고, 그에 따른 예산을 효과적으로 운영해 본 경험이 있는 분

The Ideal Candidate: Leadership (Culture Book 5.0 핵심가치 기반)

  • 책임에 기반한 자율 (Responsible Autonomy): 지시를 기다리지 않고 마케팅·커뮤니케이션의 과제를 스스로 정의하고, 결과까지 책임지는 리더
  • 불굴 (Grit): 데이터와 사실에 근거해 집요하게 파고들고, 가장 큰 임팩트를 만드는 곳에 집중하는 리더
  • 성장 마인드셋 (Growth Mindset): 익숙한 방식 대신 AI 등 새로운 방식을 먼저 시도하고, 실패에서 배운 점을 팀의 자산으로 만드는 리더
  • 원팀 (One Team): 세일즈·프로덕트·재무·경영진과 원칙 기반으로 협업하며, 회사 전체의 성공을 기준으로 판단하는 리더
  • Player-Coach: 전략가이자 실행가로서 직접 AI로 결과물을 만들며 팀과 함께 뛰는 리더

우대사항

  • 기업 브랜드 리뉴얼(리브랜딩) 또는 브랜드 메시지 체계 재정립을 리딩해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 사업 전환, 대규모 투자 유치 등 회사의 주요 성장 전환기에 기업 커뮤니케이션을 이끌어 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 이슈·위기 커뮤니케이션 체계를 구축하고 실제 상황에 대응해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 업계 전문가로서 웨비나, 컨퍼런스 등 대외 발표와 경영진 메시지 기획에 자신 있는 분
  • SEO/GEO 등 AI 시대의 검색·콘텐츠 노출 전략에 대한 이해가 있는 분
  • 글로벌 비즈니스 환경에서 비즈니스 레벨 이상의 유창한 영어 구사 능력을 갖추신 분

팀의 AI 활용 방식

Marcom팀은 Claude Code, ChatGPT, 사내 LLM 에이전트를 실무에 사용하고 있으며, 반복되는 분석과 리포트는 이미 자동화되어 있습니다. 메타 광고 성과 리포트, 협력광고 성과 분석, SEO/GEO/PR 모니터링 대시보드 등을 활용하고 있습니다.

Buzzvil에서만 누릴 수 있는 경험

  • 핵심 미션: 리워드 광고 회사에서 인터랙션 AI 에이전트 기업으로 진화하는 버즈빌의 이야기를 직접 설계하고, 고객과 업계, 언론에 일관된 목소리로 전달합니다.
  • 성장 기회: 전 구성원이 AI를 일상적인 업무 도구로 활용하는 환경에서, 마케팅이 일하는 방식을 직접 재설계합니다.
  • 비즈니스 임팩트: CEO 및 리더십 팀과 직접 협업하며, 브랜드·PR·마케팅을 하나의 전략으로 묶어 기업 가치와 매출 성장에 기여합니다.

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

Modelo operacional e processos

  • Desenhar o modelo operacional da vertical e ser dona dos processos ponta a ponta: adesão, emissão, movimentações, cobrança, cancelamentos e devoluções;
  • Implantar cada novo produto e parceiro com fluxos, integrações, testes e checklist de lançamento, para que crescer não dependa de improviso;
  • Governar a troca de dados com seguradoras e parceiros: arquivos de movimentação e retorno, batimento de bases e qualidade cadastral;

IA e automação

  • Identificar onde IA e automação removem trabalho manual da operação (conciliações, batimento de bases, pendências, triagem de demandas);
  • Medir o ganho de cada automação em tempo, erros e custo e replicar o que funciona em outros fluxos;

Conciliação e controles

  • Construir e operar as conciliações contra contrato: prêmios, comissões, cancelamentos e devoluções;
  • Desenhar controles e tratar incidentes com causa raiz e plano de ação, deixando a vertical pronta para auditorias internas e de parceiros;

Obrigações de quem distribui seguros

  • Garantir, com Jurídico e Compliance, as obrigações operacionais de cada modelo de distribuição: repasse de prêmios nos prazos, comunicações aos segurados, transparência de remuneração, evidências de contratação e dados para PLD;

Programa corporativo

  • Ser dona do programa de seguros corporativos do iFood (D&O, cyber, vida em grupo e demais linhas): P&L, inventário de apólices e contratos, calendário de renovações e adequação de coberturas;
  • Conduzir renovações e colocações com corretoras e seguradoras, do diagnóstico de riscos à negociação de condições, com Jurídico, Finanças e áreas envolvidas;
  • Revisar coberturas sempre que o negócio muda (novos produtos, operações ou aquisições) junto com Riscos e Jurídico;

Parceiros

  • Governar a relação com corretoras e seguradoras: SLAs, indicadores, rituais de acompanhamento e negociação dentro dos contratos;
  • Gerir a operação terceirizada de atendimento e pós-venda: SLAs, qualidade e tratamento de reclamações;

Dados e decisão

  • Garantir a integridade dos números da área: fechamento mensal, indicadores e relatórios gerenciais como fonte única para a liderança decidir;
  • Ser a interface de Seguros com Tecnologia e Dados: consolidar, priorizar e especificar o que a operação precisa para escalar;

Dia a dia

  • Estruturar a operação de sinistros: aviso, documentação, acompanhamento junto às seguradoras e experiência de quem aciona o seguro;
  • Programa corporativo governado, P&L mensal e primeiro ciclo de renovações sem sustos;
  • Conciliações de todos os produtos rodando todo mês, com divergências tratadas e vazamentos estancados;
  • Checklist de lançamento em uso: novo produto ou parceiro só entra com a operação pronta;
  • Fechamento mensal e relatórios gerenciais como fonte única dos números da área;
  • Obrigações de distribuidor mapeadas por produto, com controles e evidências organizados;

Ingredientes que buscamos

Vivência em seguros nas duas frentes da vaga, com profundidade em pelo menos uma e conhecimento prático da outra:

  • Operações num distribuidor (corretora, bancassurance, afinidades, varejo, fintech ou insurtech): ciclo de vida de apólices e certificados, movimentações, cobrança, repasses, comissões e conciliações;
  • Programa corporativo (D&O, cyber, vida em grupo, patrimonial ou similares): coberturas, renovações, colocação e gestão de corretora;
  • Visão de negócio: conecta processo a resultado e defende prioridades com números;
  • Gosto por construir em ambiente de mudança: testa coisas novas e decide sem ter todas as respostas;
  • Mão na massa com dados: monta conciliações e relatórios do zero, não delega o desenho;
  • Interesse real por IA e automação e disposição para aprender rápido: redesenhar fluxos com essas ferramentas faz parte das metas desde o primeiro dia;
  • Experiência cobrando performance e renegociando com parceiros críticos.

Capacidade de influenciar

  • Automações ou soluções de IA postas em produção, com ganho medido;
  • Conhecimento das obrigações operacionais de cada modelo de distribuição: corretagem, representação e estipulação;
  • Passagem por empresa de tecnologia, plataforma ou fintech, com fluência em ambiente matricial será um diferencial;
  • SQL ou ferramentas de BI;
  • Experiência liderando pessoas.

Somos AI FIRST

Aqui, IA não é um projeto — é um princípio que orienta a forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Você vai aprender a usar o Toqan, nossa plataforma interna de Inteligência Artificial. Nossos times utilizam IA como multiplicador de força. Isso significa que você vai redesenhar a sua função, criando agentes de IA. Esses agentes passam a executar tarefas que tradicionalmente demandariam horas de dedicação, para que você foque nas atividades que geram mais valor. Já temos milhares de agentes rodando: automatizando processos e otimizando decisões. Os próximos podem nascer das suas ideias.

Diversidade & Inclusão

No iFood, acreditamos na força e na diversidade das nossas pessoas para mover o impossível. Por isso, não fazemos distinções (deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética) em nossos processos seletivos.

https://fluz.app/us/job/account-manager-.description_html:
Fluz is a rewards-first payments company. We build the virtual card and gift card infrastructure that lets people and businesses earn on spending they were already doing, and we let other companies embed that same infrastructure into their own products through our API. We issue virtual cards, run wallets and virtual bank accounts, and move serious volume every month across consumer, corporate and enterprise programs.

We’re a small team that ships fast. We’ve just reorganized into three GM-led business lines, and we’re hiring a General Manager for each.

This role runs Corporate Card. It’s a spend management platform that pays for itself. Businesses control team spend, issue unlimited virtual corporate cards with real controls, pay bills, and earn cash back on everyday expenses, all without leaving the bank they already use. Our cards run on decoupled debit, so they fund straight from an account the customer already has, with no migration, no credit check and no per-user fees. Rewards are actual cash, posted the moment a transaction clears, and on procurement and concentrated merchant spend, the discounts get deep enough to change a company’s cost base rather than just decorate it.

We serve the full range, from early-stage startups issuing their first few cards through to enterprises running serious purchasing volume, on one platform that scales with them, and companies can use it through our app or integrate directly via API. Over 9,000 businesses use it, and we’ve paid out more than $100M in cash back so far.

The role

At Fluz, an account manager is called a Sidekick. You get a named book of corporate spending accounts, you carry a revenue number on it, and you’re expected to grow it.

These are businesses that buy at real volume across procurement, media buying, travel, gifting and inventory. Some arrived as small teams and grew into it; others were already at scale when they signed. Either way, growth here comes from expansion rather than new logos. An account that starts with one department buying gift cards can become five departments running card spend, travel and cardholders across the business. Finding and unlocking that is most of the job.

Part of it is making sure a large order never fails for a preventable reason. When a customer plans a six-figure purchase, funding, limits and timing have to be right in advance. Getting that wrong once costs more trust than a quarter of good service earns back.

You’re also how new things reach the market. We ship constantly: new products, new merchants and deeper rates, new controls, new ways to fund and pay. None of it matters until customers actually use it. When something launches, you’re expected to know it is cold, work out which accounts in your book it’s right for, and go sell it in. Not announce it. Sell it.

What you’ll do

  • Own a named book of corporate accounts and act as their operator, not their ticket queue
  • Monitor spend daily by account and by merchant, and chase declines and dips before the customer notices them
  • Maintain rate agreements: renegotiate as volume changes, handle reconciliations and payouts, and kill rates that are underwater
  • Manage limits, funding capacity and cut-off timing so a large planned order clears the first time
  • Expand accounts: more of the product (procurement through gift cards, bill pay, virtual bank accounts, travel card), more departments, more cardholders, more merchants
  • Take everything we launch to your book: know what’s shipping, work out which accounts it’s right for, and sell it in rather than announce it
  • Handle exceptions with evidence and a recommendation: refunds, capture discrepancies, failed transactions, returns, fee waivers
  • Run quarterly business reviews covering spend, earn delivered, rate performance and what’s coming
  • Bring back what you learn: what landed, what didn’t, and what your customers keep asking for that we don’t have yet
  • Keep account records current on every rate, exception and commitment

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in B2B account management carrying a revenue number
  • Experience with accounts that spend at scale; you should be comfortable when a single transaction is larger than some people’s quota
  • Detail-level command of the product. When a large order fails, the customer calls you, and you should be able to answer
  • Strong commercial instinct on rate versus margin. You can tell when a customer is costing you money, and you act on it
  • Skill at multi-stakeholder relationships across accounts payable, procurement, finance and operations
  • Numerate and organized. You’ll be reconciling real dollars
  • Someone who goes looking for expansion rather than waiting for the customer to ask

Bonus points

  • You’ve managed corporate card, expense management or corporate gifting programs
  • You’ve handled payment operations issues: chargebacks, returns, settlement timing, funding cut-offs
  • You’ve run QBRs that customers actually found useful

How you’ll be measured

Month-over-month and year-over-year spend growth on your book. Net revenue after rate cost. Logo and dollar retention. Expansion into new merchants, products and departments.

Why this role

Corporate Card is the line with the clearest runway. The product is built, the customers are real businesses with real budgets, and there’s meaningful unclaimed expansion sitting inside the existing base. You’d be early enough to take a lot of it.

https://fluz.app/us/job/account-manager-.description_html:
Fluz is a rewards-first payments company. We build the virtual card and gift card infrastructure that lets people and businesses earn on spending they were already doing — and we let other companies embed that same infrastructure into their own products through our API. We issue virtual cards, run wallets and virtual bank accounts, and move serious volume every month across consumer, corporate and enterprise programs.

We’re a small team that ships fast. We’ve just reorganized into three GM-led business lines and we’re hiring across all of them.

This role sits in Platform — our embedded finance business.

Embedded finance means other companies use our technology to put payment features inside their own products, under their own brand. A loyalty app that wants to hand its users a spendable virtual card. An HR platform that needs to send employee rewards. A marketplace paying out sellers. A survey company compensating participants. Rather than build card issuing, wallets, compliance and payout rails themselves — years of work and a banking relationship most companies can’t get — they connect to us and launch in weeks. Their customers see their brand; we’re the infrastructure underneath.

We cover the full range of how money moves: pay-ins (bringing funds in), wallets (holding and governing them), spend (branded virtual cards with merchant and category controls), rewards (gift cards and prepaid delivered instantly), and disbursement (open-loop payouts). Clients use one piece or all five. We’ve processed $5 billion across cards, wallets, pay-ins, payouts and bill payments, and clients integrate through our APIs, drop-in adapters, or low-code widgets. Our developer documentation is public if you want to see what we actually hand to a client.

The role

At Fluz, an account manager is called a Sidekick. On Platform, you own a book of live embedded finance clients — companies running their own card, payout or gift card programs on our infrastructure — and you’re accountable for their volume, their revenue and their renewal.

These clients have engineering teams and their end users feel every problem immediately. When approval rates dip or settlement is late, it’s their customers who notice. You need to catch that before they call you, and you need to be credible when you explain what happened.

You’re also how new things reach the market. We ship constantly — new card types, new wallet and payout capabilities, new funding methods, new ways to integrate — and none of it matters until clients actually put it into production. When something launches, you’re expected to know it is cold, work out which clients it’s right for, and go sell it in. Not announce it. Sell it. With a technical client that means making the case to a product owner and earning a slot on their roadmap, which is a harder sell than a release note and a far more valuable one.

Half the job is commercial: tier progression, true-ups, minimums, expansion, renewal. The other half is operational and technical. Most people are good at one. We’re looking for someone good at both.

What you’ll do

  • Own a named book of live Platform clients as their primary commercial and operational contact
  • Monitor volume, approval rates, decline reasons, chargebacks and settlement daily — investigate deviations before the client raises them
  • Run the operating cadence: regular operational syncs, monthly volume and revenue reviews, quarterly business reviews
  • Manage the commercial relationship: tier progression, true-ups, minimums, renegotiation, invoicing questions, breakage reconciliation
  • Expand accounts across the platform — a client live on payouts may need wallets, spend controls, pay-ins or rewards next, plus new card types, programs and geographies
  • Take new platform capabilities to your clients as they ship: identify who they’re right for, make the case, and get them into production
  • Be the escalation path into our operations, engineering, compliance and banking partners, and own the communication back to the client
  • Keep clients compliant: periodic reviews, refreshed due diligence, and advance notice for program changes that need bank sign-off
  • Feed the product roadmap — what your clients need next, and what it’s worth

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years in technical account management or partner management in payments or embedded finance
  • Commercially sharp and technically credible in the same conversation — you can discuss a rate tier and a webhook failure in the same call
  • Detail-level command of the platform — enough to diagnose a client’s problem before engineering sees it
  • Strong incident and escalation instincts. You know what to communicate, to whom, and how fast
  • Excellent written communication with enterprise clients
  • Comfort reading transaction data and finding the anomaly yourself

Bonus points

  • You’ve supported card issuing, payouts, wallets or gift card programs at an infrastructure provider
  • You’ve worked within a sponsor bank model and know what triggers a bank conversation
  • You’ve owned renewals and expansion, not just health

How you’ll be measured

Month-over-month and year-over-year volume and net revenue by client. Actual volume against contracted volume. Renewal and expansion. Client-reported incident volume and time to resolution.

Why this role

Platform is where the company is placing its biggest bet, and it’s early enough that your accounts will materially move the number. You’ll have direct access to engineering and to the founders, and what you say clients need has a real chance of getting built.

About Fringe

Fringe is a fast-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down-to-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.

We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.

Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.

We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.

If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.

About the Role

Fringe reaches employers two ways: directly, by working with HR leaders who want a better way to care for their people, and through partners like ADP, where Fringe is available to the employers who already trust ADP to run their HR and payroll. Partner-sourced deals move differently. They're warmer, faster, and come with a partner in the room. Direct deals take more discovery, more storytelling, and more hustle. We need someone who's great at both.

You'll be an Account Executive focused on ADP-specific opportunities, alongside a book of our smaller direct deals. You'll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed contract, work closely with our partnership team and ADP's sales teams, and partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to make sure every new client gets off to a great start.

This is a role for a seller who loves variety and wants to help build something. The ADP motion is still growing, which means you'll do more than close deals. You'll help shape the playbook. It's a lot of hats and a rare amount of ownership, visibility, and impact.

What you'll own

ADP partnership deals

  • Run ADP-sourced opportunities end to end: discovery, demo, proposal, and close, often on a much faster timeline than a traditional sales cycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with ADP sales reps and partner teams so Fringe is top of mind when their clients ask about recognition, rewards, and employee experience.
  • Learn the ADP co-sell motion inside and out, and help turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success so partner-sourced clients launch quickly and see value from day one.

Direct opportunities

  • Own a pipeline of smaller direct deals, typically HR leaders at growing companies who wear a lot of hats.
  • Run sharp, tailored demos that show how Fringe helps a small HR team deliver a best-in-class employee experience without juggling a pile of vendors.
  • Work inbound leads, referrals, and targeted outbound with intention and consistent follow-through.
  • Keep Salesforce clean, your pipeline current, and your forecast honest.

Cross-functional partner

  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to win deals together and set clients up for success.
  • Bring back what you're hearing from prospects and partners, and help sharpen our pitch, our process, and our product.

Who you are

  • A natural self-starter. You build your own momentum, manage your own day, and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to hit your number.
  • Versatile. You can run a fast, partner-sourced deal in the morning and a thoughtful direct discovery call in the afternoon, and you enjoy the switch.
  • Open-minded and coachable. You're curious about new ways of selling, welcome feedback, and adapt quickly when something isn't working.
  • A true collaborator. You know the best deals are won together, and you treat partners and teammates like they're on your team, because they are.
  • Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.

Need to haves

  • Experience owning the full sales cycle, from discovery through close.

  • Quality communicator, written and verbal.

Nice to haves

  • Experience selling HR technology or into HR, benefits, or people teams.
  • SaaS sales experience.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers, or co-selling alongside a larger platform. ADP experience is a big plus.

What we offer

Deine Rolle

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

 

 

The Role

Fanatics Financial Services is at the center of Fanatics' ambition to build the world's leading digital sports platform. The Director, Financial Services Partnerships & Business Development will be a senior, externally-facing deal leader responsible for driving high-impact partnerships across financial services and loyalty.   

This individual will own a pipeline of prospective partnerships, leading conversations with senior executives at target companies, structuring deals, and driving them through to launch. They will bring a sharp commercial instinct, deep knowledge of the financial services and loyalty landscapes, and the credibility and hunger to be a primary driver of new partnership value for Fanatics. 

The Director, Financial Services Partnerships & Business Development reports directly to the VP of Enterprise Business Development and works closely with leaders across Loyalty, Commerce, Betting & Gaming, Legal, Finance, and Product. 

 

What You'll Do

  • Partnership Development & Deal Leadership
    • Drive the full business development lifecycle for financial services and loyalty partnerships from prospecting and outreach through term sheet, negotiation, and close
    • Lead partner-facing conversations and presentations, representing Fanatics' value proposition with authority and conviction at the senior executive level
    • Build and manage a robust pipeline of prospective partners across financial services and loyalty, including travel, dining, entertainment, retail, and other categories that create compelling value for Fanatics fans
    • Structure deal economics, partnership frameworks, and value exchange models in collaboration with Finance, Legal, and Product
    • Drive negotiation of key commercial terms and contract provisions, coordinating with Legal and the VP as needed
    • Support partner relationships post-close, ensuring strong ongoing engagement and partnership performance 
  • Strategy & Market Intelligence 
    • Contribute to and help shape Fanatics' financial services and loyalty partnership strategy in collaboration with the VP of Enterprise BD
    • Identify white space opportunities across the financial services and loyalty landscapes where Fanatics' 130M+ user base, sports assets, and platform create differentiated value for partners
    • Develop a loyalty partnership roadmap focused on bringing incremental value to members through experiential benefits, everyday earning opportunities, and exclusive fan-first offers
    • Monitor competitive dynamics, emerging trends in consumer financial services and loyalty, and the broader digital sports ecosystem to inform deal prioritization and positioning 
  • Cross-Functional Execution 
    • Partner with Loyalty, Product, Marketing, and Finance to shape partnership structures that are commercially attractive and operationally executable
    • Develop compelling pitch materials, financial models, and business cases to support partner conversations and secure internal alignment
    • Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on deal structuring, regulatory considerations, and contract execution
    • Serve as a senior point of contact for strategic partners post-close, ensuring strong relationships and partnership performance 

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience
    • 8–12 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or management consulting, with meaningful exposure to financial services, loyalty, or consumer platforms
    • Demonstrated track record of leading and closing complex, high-value partnerships, including managing partner relationships and negotiations at the senior executive level
    • Strong understanding of the consumer financial services landscape and how partnerships can create value for both companies and end customers
    • Experience with loyalty program partnerships including an understanding of earn/burn mechanics, member value proposition design, and coalition-style or co-brand partnerships
    • Prior experience in a sports, entertainment, e-commerce, or consumer platform environment is a plus 
  • Skills & Attributes
    • A natural deal leader that is comfortable owning partner conversations end-to-end and driving towards close with urgency and commercial discipline
    • Strong financial and analytical acumen; ability to build and communicate ROI-driven business cases with clarity
    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Capable of distilling complex deal structures into crisp, compelling narratives for both partners and internal stakeholders
    • Highly organized and execution-oriented; able to manage multiple complex deal processes simultaneously in a fast-moving environment
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action; comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at driving alignment across decentralized organizations
    • Collaborative and humble, with the interpersonal credibility to build trust across functions and levels
    • A genuine passion for sports and belief in Fanatics' mission to relentlessly enhance the fan experience

Why This Role Matters 

Financial services and loyalty partnerships are two of the highest-leverage growth vectors for Fanatics. This Director will be one of the primary drivers of new strategic partnerships on the team, operating with the autonomy and ambition of a senior deal leader and backed by the brand power of a category-defining sports platform, as well as relationships with 130M+ fans, leagues, teams, and athletes. The partnerships you close will directly shape the fan experience and the future of Fanatics 

 

 

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$215,000—$230,000 USD

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

Affiliate Marketing ist für Dich mehr als Kampagnenmanagement? Du möchtest neue Affiliate-Partnerschaften aufbauen, Potenziale identifizieren und unser Affiliate-Geschäft aktiv weiterentwickeln?

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

Unsere Website wird jeden Monat von mehreren Millionen Nutzern besucht und bietet damit großes Potenzial, relevante Touchpoints entlang der Customer Journey gezielt zu bespielen und zu monetarisieren. In dieser Rolle baust Du unser Affiliate-Netzwerk weiter aus, gewinnst neue Partner und entwickelst bestehende Kooperationen weiter. Affiliate bedeutet bei uns dabei mehr als klassisches Partnermanagement: Je nach Touchpoint platzieren wir entlang unserer Customer Journey passende Partnerangebote und Affiliate-Modelle von CPO-basierten Angeboten bis hin zu lead- oder performancebasierten Modellen.

KI verändert dieses Geschäft bereits jetzt spürbar neue Touchpoints entstehen, Partner-Analysen werden datengetriebener, Prozesse automatisierter. Wir setzen langfristig auf den Einsatz von KI in unserer Arbeit und suchen jemanden, der Lust hat, diesen Wandel im Affiliate-Geschäft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dein Spielfeld

  • Du identifizierst und akquirierst neue Affiliate- und Kooperationspartner.
  • Du betreust bestehende Affiliate-Partnerschaften und entwickelst diese gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern weiter.
  • Du steuerst die Anbindung neuer Affiliate-Partner in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit IT, Produktmanagement, Vertrieb, Finance und Legal zusammen.
  • Du analysierst die Performance bestehender Partnerschaften auch mithilfe KI-gestützter Tools und leitest Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Du beobachtest Markttrends, insbesondere den wachsenden Einfluss von KI auf Customer Journeys und Affiliate-Modelle, und bringst neue Ideen für den Ausbau unseres Affiliate-Geschäfts ein.

Das macht Dich aus

  • Du bringst mehrjährige, einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Affiliate Management mit im Aufbau, in der Steuerung und der Weiterentwicklung von Partnerprogrammen.
  • Du kennst Dich mit Affiliate-Netzwerken und gängigen Vergütungsmodellen wie CPO, CPL und CPS aus und hast bereits mit Publishern, Advertisern oder Netzwerken zusammengearbeitet.
  • Du bist offen im Umgang mit KI-Tools und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Analyse- oder Automatisierungslösungen im Marketing-Kontext.
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative und Freude daran, neue Themen voranzutreiben.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Was wir für Dich parat haben

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld mit spannenden Projekten und namhaften Partnern.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und direkter Einfluss auf den Ausbau unseres Affiliate-Geschäfts.
  • Die Möglichkeit, den langfristigen Einsatz von KI in unserem Affiliate-Geschäft von Anfang an mitzugestalten.
  • Ein motiviertes Team, das neue Ideen schätzt und gemeinsam etwas bewegen möchte.
  • Flexibilität durch die Möglichkeit, einen Tag pro Woche im Home-Office zu arbeiten.

Zusätzliche Benefits

50 € steuerfreier Sachbezug pro Monat (nach erfolgreicher Probezeit) & ein attraktiver Mahlzeitenzuschuss für deine Office-Tage.

Monizze is on a mission to help employers support the well-being and engagement of their people.
From our roots in electronic meal, eco, and gift vouchers, we’ve evolved into a comprehensive Reward Management System, offering smart, flexible, and human-centered salary solutions.

To further strengthen our position in the premium segment of the market, we are looking for a driven and commercially strong Corporate Business Developer.

Are you a motivated business developer who thrives on winning leading corporate clients? Do you effortlessly identify strategic opportunities and act as a fully fledged sparring partner at C-level? Then this could be the perfect next step in your career.

Your advantages first

💪 Your purchasing power is optimized – the motto is true for clients & employees
🌴 30 days off per year: 20 legal holidays + 6 ADV/RTT + 4 Monidayzz
🚙 A company car
🏠 Homeworking flexibility with days of remote work and a monthly allowance to make it comfy
🌍 Work from abroad up to 4 weeks a year (after 6 months @ Monizze)
🧇 Belgian roots, mindset & attitude: a cool and informal atmosphere – one of the best things since waffles
🚀 Disrupting and innovative: we digitalized the market and keep pushing innovation in every aspect
🧠 Your growth is our growth: unlimited learning opportunities (languages, personal growth, hard skills,...)
👪 Your health and your family's health is covered by our hospitalization insurance
✨ Internal mobility is regularly an option for anyone looking to evolve or change jobs or departments
🏠 Homeworking opportunities and overall flexibility
🧳 A yearly trip with all your colleagues to celebrate our achievements
➕ We do much more for our employees, but we needed space to describe the job! We'd love to tell you about it though, so ask us!

Key Responsibilities

As Corporate Business Developer, you will be a driving force behind our growth in the corporate segment. Your focus will be on large companies with more than 1,000 employees. You will act as a strategic partner to these organisations, helping them optimise their remuneration policies and employee benefits strategies.

In addition to developing direct corporate business, you will play a key role in identifying, building and expanding strategic partnerships that strengthen Monizze’s position in the market. This includes developing relationships with professional networks, industry organisations and ecosystem partners, such as our existing partnership with Federgon.

  • High-level hunting: Strategically map the corporate market and open doors with the right stakeholders. Targeted social selling, smart networking at C-level events and highly personalised outreach campaigns will be central to your approach.

  • Strategic consulting: Engage with HR Directors, Compensation & Benefits Managers, CFOs and CEOs. Understand their challenges and translate them into smart solutions in the areas of salary optimisation and employee benefits.

  • Build lasting relationships: Your relationship-building skills are one of your greatest assets. You will develop a strong and sustainable network within the corporate world and position yourself as a trusted expert.

  • Develop strategic partnerships: Identify relevant partners and create mutually valuable collaborations with professional federations, industry organisations and other key players in the HR and business ecosystem. You will further develop existing partnerships, such as Federgon, and explore new opportunities that generate commercial value and strengthen Monizze’s market presence.

  • Close the deal: Manage the entire sales process, from the first introduction to pricing negotiations and the final signature.

  • Spot market trends: Keep your finger on the pulse of the HR world and share valuable insights with our internal teams to further improve our products and services.

  • Represent Monizze externally: Act as an ambassador for Monizze at industry events, networking opportunities and partner meetings, helping to increase our visibility and credibility within the corporate market.

Qualifications

We are looking for a strategic thinker with strong influencing skills and sharp business insights. You have the maturity to manage complex sales cycles and combine in-depth expertise with a consultative approach at C-level.

  • Corporate sales expertise: You are results-oriented, proactive and have a proven track record in B2B sales, preferably within the large enterprise segment.

  • Natural networker: You have excellent interpersonal skills and can communicate effectively at different levels. You feel equally comfortable in boardrooms and at networking events.

  • Partnership mindset: You know how to identify, develop and manage strategic partnerships that create value for all parties. You are skilled at building relationships with industry organisations, professional federations and other influential stakeholders.

  • HR expertise: You have in-depth knowledge of HR processes, remuneration policies and salary optimisation in Belgium. You understand how to create value for both employers and employees.

  • Multilingual professional: You are fluent in Dutch, French and English. You can present, advise and negotiate convincingly in all three languages.

  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development.

  • Professional autonomy: You work independently in a corporate environment, proactively manage your own agenda and pipeline, and move smoothly between strategic thinking and operational execution.

Join Monizze in this exciting phase of growth and be a key player in shaping the future of our business. Apply now to be part of a dynamic team and contribute to the success of Monizze in the corporate solutions market.

https://jobs.monizze.be/o/head-of-market.description_html:
About Monizze

Monizze is the Belgian challenger in employee benefits and purchasing power. We move faster than the incumbents, we test more than they do, and we're not interested in doing marketing the way it's always been done. If you want to run a team from a dashboard and a quarterly plan, this isn't your role. If you want to lead four specialists, get into the detail with them and make the whole thing perform as one engine, keep reading. 

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a strategy-only or advisory position. You combine people-management experience with enough functional & tactical marketing expertise to manage, challenge and support specialists in their day-to-day work.

Your job in one line: make the marketing squads operate as connected, accountable and performance-driven delivery teams.

Your advantages first

💪 Your purchasing power is optimized – the motto is true for clients & employees
🌴 30 days off per year: 20 legal holidays + 6 ADV/RTT + 4 Monidayzz
🚙 A mobility budget
🏠 Homeworking flexibility with days of remote work and a monthly allowance to make it comfy
🌍 Work from abroad up to 4 weeks a year (after 6 months @ Monizze)
🧇 Belgian roots, mindset & attitude: a cool and informal atmosphere – one of the best things since waffles
🚀 Disrupting and innovative: we digitalized the market and keep pushing innovation in every aspect
🧠 Your growth is our growth: unlimited learning opportunities (languages, personal growth, hard skills,...)
👪 Your health and your family's health is covered by our hospitalization insurance
✨ Internal mobility is regularly an option for anyone looking to evolve or change jobs or departments
🏠 Homeworking opportunities and overall flexibility
🧳 A yearly trip with all your colleagues to celebrate our achievements
➕ We do much more for our employees, but we needed space to describe the job! We'd love to tell you about it though, so ask us!

Lead and develop 4 specialists

You manage, coach and develop four leads, with enough depth to challenge and support each of them on their own terrain:

  • growth & revenue marketing: campaign angle, paid media, lifecycle design, cross-sell, upsell and product adoption

  • marketing ops & automation: MCAE/Pardot architecture, segmentation, scoring, the tooling stack, UTM governance, deliverability and GDPR-grade data quality

  • web, content & SEO: the multilingual site (NL/FR/EN) as an acquisition and conversion channel, landing pages, CRO, SEO/GEO/AEO

  • events, partner & affiliation: partner activation, co-marketing, affiliation as its own commercial motion, and lead handoff

You set priorities, expectations and ownership. You review work, challenge choices, remove blockers and raise the bar, while execution stays with the owners.

Run the squad

  • own the squad way of working across the whole marketing team, not only your four direct reports, and make sure it works in practice

  • set and protect the cadence: planning, prioritisation, ownership, delivery follow-up, decisions, retrospectives

  • coordinate dependencies with Sales, Product, Customer Experience, Data and IT

  • hold a consolidated view of priorities, capacity, progress and risk, and step in early when delivery slips

Make the tools earn their place

  • make sure marketing runs on the right stack, used to its full potential and drive best-practice adoption so tooling knowledge doesn't sit with one person

  • your specialists propose the tools; you and the CMO decide together what marketing runs on

  • keep AI embedded in daily execution: agents, skills and workflows that save real time

Drive connected, measurable execution

The pieces have to add up to one story, told the same way whether someone meets us through an ad, the website, a partner event or a sales call.

  • make web, campaigning and automation work as one acquisition and growth engine

  • hold the red thread across paid, web, email, events and the sales conversation

  • turn performance data into decisions, optimisations and next experiments, with KPIs and metrics that support qualified lead success rather than raw volume

Partner closely with the CMO

  • short lines and regular, concise exchanges on priorities, delivery, team dynamics and risk

  • assist in translating the CMO's direction into a realistic operational roadmap, with clear recommendations when trade-offs are needed

  • create transparency without piling on reporting overhead

What this role doesn’t hold

  • you don't set overall marketing strategy or brand direction. That sits with the CMO, and you turn it into execution that works

  • you don't manage product marketing, comms/PR or brand & creative. Those specialists report to the CMO and you work with them as peer

  • you're not doing the specialists' work for them. You challenge, unblock and raise the bar; execution stays with the owners. You need enough depth to hold the conversation, not to take over the keyboard

What stays yours: whether the team delivers, at what quality, and with what commercial impact.

What we’re looking for

  • proven experience managing and developing marketing specialists with distinct areas of expertise

  • experience coordinating multidisciplinary delivery through clear priorities, cadence, ownership and follow-up

  • commercial and analytical mindset: you connect marketing activity to pipeline, adoption and revenue

  • enough fluency in product marketing, comms/PR and brand & creative to be credible in the room without owning them

  • broad lifecycle expertise across acquisition, conversion, onboarding, retention and expansion

  • experience in B2B, B2B2C, fintech, HR tech, SaaS or another multi-product environment is a plus

  • a multilingual people leader who can build trust, give direct feedback and challenge specialists in Dutch, French and English

  • someone who wants to take ownership of this role over the long term and work closely with the team on a sustained basis. Short-term or project-only assignments are not the focus

The profile

  • a player-coach, comfortable moving between people leadership, squad orchestration and detailed marketing discussions

  • creates clarity and momentum without micromanaging or becoming the bottleneck

  • decisive and pragmatic, comfortable making trade-offs in a fast-moving environment

  • constructive but demanding on quality, with strong communication and stakeholder skills

  • AI is already embedded in how you work. You build and optimise your own skills, agents and workflows, expect the same from your team, and can tell where AI raises quality rather than just volume

Why join Monizze?

Monizze sits at the intersection of purchasing power, payments, mobility and employee benefits. A Belgian challenger with genuine ambition and the pace to match. You'll take a strong specialist team and make it operate as one connected marketing engine, with direct influence on how the next stage of growth actually gets delivered.

If you'd rather build a team that performs than write the plan for one, let's talk.

Marsello helps retailers know their customers and keep them coming back. We're growing across APAC, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us win the next wave of retail brands.

You'll begin with a real head start. There's a steady flow of inbound leads from retailers who already want to talk. The challenge, and the fun, is going out and finding the ones who don't know about us yet. You'll convert inbound interest, build your own pipeline through outbound, and run demos that uncover needs retailers didn't know they had. You'll do it alongside a supportive, high-energy sales team that's in your corner.

If you know your way around SaaS, love the chase as much as the close, and want targets you can actually beat with a product retailers genuinely need, this is a role where you'll have the leads to hit your number and the freedom to smash it.

What you'll own

  • Inbound that's ready to go. Retailers come to us looking for a better way to keep their customers coming back. You'll pick up those leads, qualify them quickly, and turn warm interest into signed customers.
  • Outbound that's yours to grow. Beyond the inbound flow, you'll go after the retailers who should be on Marsello but aren't yet. You'll decide who to target, start the conversation, and build a pipeline that wouldn't exist without you. This is where great AEs make their mark.
  • The first conversation. For most prospective customers, you'll be their first real experience of Marsello. You'll run the demos, present the product, and ask the questions that get to what a retailer actually needs.
  • Your numbers. You'll carry a target and be trusted to hit it, and then to beat it, with a sales team that shares what works and celebrates the wins.

What we're looking for

  • A proven sales track record of hitting and beating targets, ideally in SaaS, retail, loyalty or marketing.
  • The discipline to work inbound leads quickly and well, and the drive to build outbound pipelines from scratch.
  • Natural confidence presenting and running demos online.
  • A tidy, well-run pipeline in a CRM.
  • A strong appreciation for technology, ideally marketing automation, cloud or SaaS, and genuine curiosity about how retailers use digital and marketing tools.
  • Excellent communication, both in writing and out loud.
  • A team-first attitude. You want to be part of a high-velocity sales team, not just a solo operator.

Why Marsello

We're a smart, close-knit team spread across New Zealand, Canada and Australia, and we back people to own their space. This role is remote, ideally based in Wellington.

Beyond the work itself, you'll get genuine flexibility in your working day, subsidised Southern Cross healthcare, a wellness allowance, a technology allowance, and even a day off for your birthday.

If you want a sales role with warm leads to work, new ground to break, and a team that has your back, we'd love to hear from you.

Customer Success Manager | NeoDay | Tilburg
🔹 Location: Tilburg (On-site 80% / Remote 20%)
🔹 Type: Full-time
🔹 Experience: Mid to senior level (4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or CRM / Loyalty Marketing)

About NeoDay

For decades, loyalty programs meant endless IT projects and ROI "somewhere in year three." We think that's broken, so we're proving the opposite. At NeoDay, we help retailers and consumer brands, from supermarkets and fashion chains to fast food and fuel stations, turn loyalty into a real growth engine. Our platform combines AI-driven personalization, gamification and ready-to-launch apps, so brands like Tesco, Action and La Place can go live in weeks instead of years.

NeoDay is the award-winning loyalty platform. We won Best Retail Loyalty Program Worldwide at the International Loyalty Awards and were named by Forrester among the world's leading loyalty platforms. Everything we build is made in-house in The Netherlands and the Philippines, and we're scaling fast across Europe and beyond.

Your role

A loyalty program isn't won on launch day. It's won in the months after: every new member, every campaign that lands, every euro of uplift on the client's books. When our clients succeed, NeoDay grows with them. You're the one who makes that happen.

As Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of our international brands from go-live onwards. You become an extension of their marketing team: the loyalty expert at the table who knows what to launch next, why it will work, and how to prove it did. Strategy, results, and a story your client can take straight to their board. You report to our Head of Customer Success and work hand-in-hand with our Solution Architects, Sales, Product, Data and Support teams.

What you'll do

  • Own your book: Be the go-to partner for a portfolio of international brands, from the loyalty manager running campaigns to the C-suite signing off on budget.

  • Define what winning looks like: Set clear goals and a proper baseline with every client, and turn them into a Success Plan you both steer on.

  • Make value impossible to ignore: Deliver campaign results, impact snapshots and benchmarks that your champions share with their leadership. The kind of numbers that get forwarded to the CEO with "have you seen this?"

  • Lead the strategic conversation: Run QBRs, shape the marketing and campaign calendar, and bring loyalty ideas that grow members, visit frequency and basket size.

  • Grow the program, grow the account: Drive adoption and the growth built into every contract. Spot expansion opportunities early and team up with Sales to land them.

  • Never rely on one champion: Map stakeholders, build relationships across marketing, IT and leadership, and make NeoDay part of how the whole organization works.

  • Be the Voice of the Customer: Bundle client feedback into sharp input for Product and bring the roadmap back to your clients. You know when to say "yes," when to say "not now," and how to say "no" so it still lands well.

  • Raise the bar for Customer Success: Help set the standard for how NeoDay partners with its clients. You bring best practices, sharpen how we work and make excellence the norm in every account.

What you bring

  • Experience: 4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or client-side CRM / loyalty marketing, ideally at a SaaS or martech company working with retail or consumer brands.

  • A marketer at heart: You speak the language of CMOs and loyalty managers. Campaigns, segments, member lifecycles and promo calendars are your home turf.

  • Data into stories: Baselines, uplift, retention. You're at home in a dashboard and you know which number matters to the board.

  • Trusted advisor: Confident in front of C-level, honest when expectations need resetting, calm when things get hectic.

  • Commercial instinct: You spot growth opportunities before the client does, and you build the business case that turns them into a yes, together with Sales.

  • Client champion: You genuinely care about your clients' success. You listen closely, act before they have to ask and build relationships that feel like partnerships.

  • Languages: Fluent in written and spoken English. Dutch is a bonus.

What you'll get

  • A competitive base salary plus an OTE component: you grow the accounts, you share in the upside.

  • 25 vacation days (based on a full-time contract).

  • A laptop and phone subscription compensation.

  • An international role with a portfolio of leading brands and real commercial impact.

  • Travel allowance / NS card.

  • Great colleagues, team events, and an informal Brabant-style culture: we perform together and enjoy together!

Why NeoDay?

NeoDay combines the energy of a scale-up with decades of combined loyalty experience. We're scaling from a handful of flagship partnerships to a customer base across Europe and beyond, and Customer Success is where that growth is won. You'll get clear goals, real ownership and the freedom to build it your way. If you want to be the reason great brands keep growing, we want to talk to you.

https://platogroup.eu/nl/vacatures/compa.description_html:
Als creatieve sparringpartner helpen we merken op te vallen met verrassende promotionele concepten. Samen met een energiek team van ruim 35 collega’s zetten we ons dagelijks in om onze klanten te voorzien van inspirerende totaaloplossingen. Ben jij een creatieve geest en wil je ons helpen merken nog meer te laten stralen? En ben je op zoek naar een Account Manager rol waar jij jouw creativiteit helemaal kwijt kunt? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Samen met een team ben je verantwoordelijk voor een belangrijke groep key accounts. Met jouw creativiteit, ondernemerschap en commercialiteit slaag jij erin om marketing doelstellingen en onderliggende behoeftes van onze klanten te vertalen naar bijbehorende promotionele oplossing die past bij de wens van de klant. Een aantal voorbeelden van klanten van ons in Nederland zijn Center Parcs, NS, Yamaha en Randstad.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Het opbouwen en verder uitbouwen van goede klantenrelaties. Je creëert en benut commerciële kansen.
  • Door jouw oprechte nieuwsgierigheid weet je de wensen van de klant goed te achterhalen en weet je deze wens om te zetten naar een perfect passend aanbod.
  • Samen met het projectteam creëer je verrassende en onderscheidende promotionele concepten voor de klanten. Dit blijft niet alleen bij promotionele artikelen, maar je denkt na over een totaaloplossing waarbij je ook kan denken aan bijvoorbeeld een webshop oplossing of een eigen lijn van promotieartikelen voor de klant.
  • Het opstellen en uitvoeren van een commercieel jaarplan voor je klanten.
  • Onderhandelen van prijzen en condities.
  • Forecasting van volume & omzetontwikkeling bij je klanten, bijsturen waar nodig en reporting richting stakeholders.
  • Naast de bestaande klanten ga je actief opzoek naar nieuwe kansen en mogelijkheden om new business te genereren.

Al met al dus een heel gevarieerde rol, waarbij je intensief samenwerkt met collega Account Managers, de commerciële binnendienst en de designers.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je gaat deel uitmaken van het Sales team in Nederland. In dit team werk je samen met 16 collega’s. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor Compacon in Nederland. Daarnaast werk je vanuit het Compacon hoofdkantoor van Europa, en dit zijn in totaal 35 collega’s die werkzaam zijn vanuit Barendrecht.

Compacon maakt onderdeel uit van Plato Group. Plato Group heeft ruim 80 jaar ervaring in de wereld van promotionele artikelen. Plato Group is overkoepelende organisatie van twee innovatieve en toonaangevende merken in onze branche; IGO Promo en Compacon. We zijn een internationale organisatie met onze hoofdvestiging in Helmond en regiokantoren in diverse Europese landen.

Sociale en ecologische duurzaamheid zijn voor ons een hoge prioriteit. We nemen verschillende maatregelen om onze impact op de planeet te verbeteren en goed te doen voor de samenleving: we doneren een deel van onze winst aan goede doelen en we gaan steeds meer over op duurzame producten. We zijn volop in beweging en een organisatie met enorm veel potentie in de Europese markt. Dit biedt volop kansen aan enthousiaste en talentvolle mensen!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een werkomgeving waar sociale- én ecologische duurzaamheid topprioriteiten zijn. Zo nemen we diverse maatregelen om onze impact op de planeet te verkleinen en bij te dragen aan een betere samenleving. Dit doen we door een deel van onze winst aan goede doelen te doneren, kansen te bieden aan mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt en door steeds meer gebruik te maken van duurzame producten!
  • Een veelzijdige functie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om mee te helpen bouwen aan een groeiend bedrijf.
  • Een plezierige werkomgeving met fijne collega’s (al zeggen we het zelf ?).
  • Een werkomgeving waar we hard werken maar met tijd voor gezelligheid, teamuitjes en het vieren van successen.
  • Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van je kwaliteiten, vakkennis en groeipotentie.
  • Een marktconform salaris en een goed secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: goede pensioensregeling, mogelijkheid om thuis te werken en 27 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

Wat neem je mee?

Als Account Manager ben je enthousiast, ondernemend en hou je van aanpakken. Je bent een doorzetter met een flinke dosis ambitie. Daarnaast is creativiteit enorm belangrijk, je vindt het leuk om out-of-the-box te denken. De kwaliteit in contact met klanten heb je zelf al in huis, je bent een volwaardig gesprekspartner voor onze grote accounts.

Daarnaast neem je het volgende met je mee:

  • Je hebt minimaal een HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in onze branche óf in een creatieve omgeving.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële functie.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32-40 uur.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B.

Durf jij het Compacon avontuur aan als Account Manager? Reageer dan zo snel mogelijk door het sollicitatieformulier in te vullen en jouw CV te uploaden. Deze kan gericht worden aan onze HR Business Partner Mariëlle Martens. Voor vragen mag je altijd contact opnemen met Mariëlle via +31 (0)6 48650950 of per e-mail via marielle.martens@platogroup.eu. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie!
